notes: Dub Agent beside your work: it starts and cancels dubs, extracts subtitles, cuts clips and burns subtitles.
Lighter setup: about 3.6 GB on Mac (was 19 GB) and about 21 GB on Windows (was 34 GB). AI models download when first used.
Perso API dubbing: the whole job can run on Perso's servers.
Dub several videos: they line up and run one after another.
Timeline under the script: zoom, click to jump, space to play, Enter to start over.
Subtitles on your video: pick one of twelve looks, set the size, drag it into place. Export previews them.
